snippet.title: Gates of Eden - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Imagine "Doom" but in Heaven. Demons, evil creatures, and rebellious warriors have taken over the Kingdom, and it's your job to restore order to paradise. Fight to protect the Garden of Eden and defeat the Prince of Darkness.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3864060/Gates_of_Eden/
